sam: Hi — customer (acct: acme-inc) reports intermittent SSE connections that close immediately after a 200 with a final partial payload missing. They see: partial chunks, then connection close, iterator never yields final EOF. Repro steps below.

devon: Which SDK/version and runtime?

sam: js-sdk@2.3.1, node 18.15, using eventsource-polyfill in EC2 env. Token rotation every 5m via short-lived creds. Happens at medium QPS (~80 r/s) and small streaming chunks.

claire: Can you paste the raw logs / SSE frames?

sam: paste logs — see below (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11.123Z] OUTBOUND: GET /v1/stream?model=redwood-mini 200
data: {"id":"c1","type":"chunk","text":"Hello wor"}\n\n
[2026-03-15T14:02:11.126Z] SOCKET: FIN, ECONNRESET
[2026-03-15T14:02:11.126Z] SDK: iterator.pause -> never resumed, no final frame
```
Also sometimes see a trailing `\r` with no newline.

maria: Could be the polyfill closing socket before parser flushes. Are you using AbortController on the request or a client-side timeout?

sam: We pass an AbortSignal for 30s global timeout in our wrapper. The customer sees this even when no abort triggered.

ryan: Quick hypothesis: parser expects final `\n\n` delimiter to emit the last event. If socket closes mid-frame (server-side close without a final newline), the parser currently drops the buffered data instead of flushing it as final event. That would leave the async iterator hanging.

claire: That matches the stack traces we've seen from other customers too (iterator awaiting end). Any repro code?

sam: Minimal repro (Node):
```
const EventSource = require('eventsource'); // polyfill
const es = new EventSource('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=test', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer <token>' } });
es.onmessage = (e) => console.log('msg', e.data);
es.onerror = (err) => console.log('err', err);
// simulate server closing mid-event with partial chunk
```
Running this against a test server that closes sockets mid-chunk reproduces the hang ~60% of runs.

support-bot: Ticket #INC-2026-118 created and escalated to eng-runtime. @ryan tagged.

devon: Two follow-ups: 1) Is there any billing impact when clients reconnect and get duplicate partial frames? 2) Can customer apply a quick workaround today?

sam: Customer reported duplicate tokens charged once when client reconnects and service resends partial chunk, so they saw doubled token accounting in one session. Need to confirm server-side dedupe.

maria: Workaround ideas: enforce server to always send final `\n\n` when closing, or client-side flush on `close` event. In JS SDK, we can add a final flush in the polyfill handler for `onclose` to force parse of partial buffer.

ryan: I'll prepare a small patch to the streaming parser to flush buffered data on socket close and treat it as a final event. Also add protection against re-delivering partially-sent tokens during reconnect (dedupe by event id). Will aim for patch v2.3.2 with tests. ETA ~72h. :hammer: :eyes:

claire: Can we add an integration test that closes connection mid-event and asserts iterator yields final partial string? Add to regression suite.

ryan: Yep, I'll add a deterministic test that simulates a socket FIN while buffer contains incomplete line.

devon: Good. For immediate mitigation, tell customer to set `sseHeartbeatIntervalMs: 15000` and disable aggressive client-side reconnects so the server has a chance to finish streaming. Also tell them to retry with native fetch streaming (if env supports it) rather than the polyfill.

sam: I'll relay that. They asked for an ETA and whether billing will be refunded for duplicates — finance/sales will triage.

support-bot: Escalation note: labeled `priority: high`, linked to INC-2026-118, added `eng-runtime` milestone.

ryan: PR opened: runtime/parse-flush-on-close (#4127). I'm also adding a metric to count mid-frame closes so we can monitor.

sam: Thanks all. I'll update the customer after Ryan's PR merges and QA verifies.

claire: Thx — please ping once staged so we can run their replay against staging. :thumbsup:
